sources.title: T-Mobile to lay off 5,000 employees, or about 7% of its workforce, in the coming weeks
sources.description: CEO Michael Sievert said the layoffs would come over the next five weeks and impact T-Mobile workers across the country — particularly those working in corporate and back-office roles, as well as some technology positions.
